description: This PHP class `ProjectActivityDetailedReportData` generates detailed report data for project activities within the OrangeHRM Time module. It retrieves and formats information about project activity durations and related metadata.

classes.name: ProjectActivityDetailedReportData
classes.description: A class responsible for generating detailed project activity report data, including total durations and employee details, formatted for external use.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the report with filtering parameters.

methods.name: normalize
methods.description: Generates and returns a normalized array of report data for project activities.

methods.name: getMeta
methods.description: Returns metadata related to the report, such as total durations and count, encapsulated in a ParameterBag.
